locator.text: Display 37.8, p. 37, in the proof of Proposition 4.10

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All four clauses are present; they are split across three files rather than written as one display, and the last two are stated on a half-line X ≥ X_i rather than at the single point X_i. X_i = 110 is `NominalProfile.Xi` (:140). G_i(η) = U(X_i,η) is `Controls.seedU_held` (:642), `Xi ≤ X → c.seedU (X, eta) = c.initialAxial eta`, with `initialAxial` (:586) the Lean name for G_i: at X = X_i this is the display's second clause, and for X > X_i it is the sentence that follows the display, 'The value U = G_i is retained'. `profiles_before_restore` (MatchingConeBounds.lean:475) carries it to the constructed field, `(c.profiles hsep).U p = c.seedU p` for p.1 ≤ c.radius·e^{-8}. 𝒟_XU(X_i,η) = 0 is `profiles_shape_radialU` (MatchingConeBounds.lean:629) verbatim — `radialPartial (c.profiles hsep).U (X, eta) = 0` for X_i ≤ X ≤ c.radius·e^{-8} — under the side hypotheses η ∈ [−1,1] and `SmallDebt F c.debt eta`, which are the construction's standing assumptions and not extra content. a(X_i,η) = 4/5 is the first conjunct of `RampParameters.final_shears` (ActivationContinuation.lean:1579), `shearA r.profiles p = 4/5` for every p.1 ≥ r.holdRadius, and `hold_lt_final` (:1546) puts X = 110 in that range; its second conjunct `shearB r.profiles p = 0` is the same ramp's version of 𝒟_XU = 0 (`shearB p = -2·p.1·radialPartial U p / E p`, the negative of the paper's b_s = 2𝒟_XU/E of (4.11)), but I do not rely on it, since `profiles_shape_radialU` states 𝒟_XU = 0 directly for the nominal profile. The one gap: `final_shears` is about `RampParameters.profiles`, the activation ramp's own field bundle, and I did not trace that it is the same object as the nominal `c.profiles` / `c.seedU` (see `not_traced`); so the a = 4/5 clause is the ramp's statement of the paper's clause, while the other three are stated for the nominal construction itself.
